name: – Isabella Lövin – § 56/2
title: REPORT on the multiannual plan for the Baltic Sea and ways forward
part_text: ‘recognises that approaches differ across the Union in the light of specific ecological, legal and socio‑economic contexts; Encourages the Member States to continue developing proportionate, science-based solutions in cooperation with stakeholders, in particular the fishing sector and coastal communities, to improve marine protection while ensuring the viability of the EU fisheries sector through a just transition;’
